summary_1line: Arjuna returns from battle sensing ill omens and, finding the camp grief‑stricken, realizes Abhimanyu has fallen and laments his son in intense sorrow.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands in the silent Pandava camp at twilight, seeing warriors with bowed heads while he realizes his son Abhimanyu is missing.
Arjuna, overcome with grief beside Krishna, raises his arms and laments the fallen Abhimanyu lying imagined on the blood‑stained battlefield.
The young hero Abhimanyu lies on the dusty battlefield at sunset, his radiant body compared to the sun fallen from the sky.
